Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
비록 지난 10년 동안 PC 게임으로 대부분 전환했지만, 제가 선호하는 주변 기기는 여전히 컨트롤러입니다.
KB+M 플레이의 장점을 이해하지만, 이미 업무용으로 이러한 도구를 사용하는 사람으로서 컨트롤러를 사용하면 두 활동을 분리하고 손목에 휴식을 줄 수 있다고 생각합니다. 또한, 비디오 게임을 오랫동안 해왔기 때문에 사용된 기술과 레이아웃이 크게 바뀌는 것을 보았지만, 일부 퍼스트 파티 컨트롤러는 조금 정체된 것 같습니다.
최근에 제가 정말 좋아하는 컨트롤러를 찾았는데, 제게 정말 인상적인 기능이 있어 그것에 대해 길게 이야기하고 싶습니다. 하지만 그것을 하기 위해서는 약간의 맥락이 필요하다고 생각합니다. 전체 역사 수업이 아니라, 이 취미에 참여하는 데 걸린 한 평생 동안 제가 가지고 있던 컨트롤러의 작은 산책입니다.
결국, 제가 이 기기에 대해 그렇게 많은 관심을 갖는 이유를 이해하실 수 있기를 바랍니다. 저는 이 기기에 대해 하루 종일 이야기할 수 있습니다.

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
PC 게임 컬렉션을 구축하기로 한 결정은 Xbox 360에서 Xbox One으로 전환하는 동안 시작되었습니다. 저는 360을 정말 좋아했지만, One은 재앙처럼 보였습니다. 모든 주요 회사에서 새 콘솔이 별로 관심을 끌지 못했고 저는 컴퓨터 정보 시스템 학교에 다니고 있었기 때문에 360 PC 동글을 구입하고 전환하기로 결심했습니다.
이러한 컨트롤러들은 모두 광범위하게 사용되었고, 360은 제가 선호하는 비대칭 스틱 배치를 가지고 있었습니다. 이 사진에 있는 컨트롤러 중 2개를 제외한 모든 컨트롤러는 스틱이 느슨하거나 흘러내리거나 버튼이 고장나거나 케이블/연결이 끊어져 현재 사용할 수 없습니다. 작동하는 두 개는 모두 3rd party Afterglows입니다(그것들에도 문제가 있습니다).
이 컨트롤러들을 정말 좋아했지만, 공식 컨트롤러들은 내구성이 가장 나빴고, 일부는 첫날부터 고장났지만 Microsoft는 제 RMA 요청을 거부했습니다.
가장 비싼 것을 시도해 보았을 때 상황은 더 악화되었습니다.

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
이 컨트롤러를 구입하기 전까지는 "값을 치르면 그만큼 얻는다"는 신화에 빠져 있었습니다. 이 엘리트 시리즈 2 컨트롤러를 구입한 이유는 첫 번째 버전에도 심각한 결함이 있다는 것을 알고 있었기 때문입니다.
컨트롤러는 약 1년 동안 사용하다가 스틱이 흔들리기 시작했고 오른쪽 버튼은 절반만 작동했습니다. 제공된 케이블은 엉망이었고 다른 컨트롤러와 호환되지 않았습니다. 블루투스를 사용하면 지연이 너무 심해서 동글이 거의 필요했습니다. 게다가 백 패드가 어떤 소프트웨어/드라이버를 사용하든 상관없이 작동하지 않았습니다. 제가 사용한 게임 중 어느 것도 그 패드를 입력으로 인식하지 못했습니다.
레이키리 프로(랩톱과 함께 번들로 제공됨)는 현재 제가 사용하는 데스크톱 전용 컨트롤러이며 현재는 잘 작동합니다. 하지만 저는 다시는 오피셜 Xbox 브랜드 컨트롤러에 돈을 쓰지 않을 것입니다. 마이크로소프트는 싫어합니다. Xbox가 망하기를 바랍니다!

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
닌텐도 스위치는 몇 년 동안 저렴한 노트북으로 살아남은 후 휴대용 게임에 대한 제 사랑을 되살려 주었습니다. 조이콘은 작지만 다재다능했고, 프로 컨트롤러는 손에 정말 편안했습니다.
저는 이 컨트롤러를 너무 좋아해서 지난 해 홀 효과 스틱 [그리고 금속 래치]로 교체하여 개조했습니다. 저는 드리프트 문제에 대해 잘 알고 있지만, 제 것들은 2017년 이후 아무런 마모의 징후 없이 완벽하게 작동했습니다. 저는 이 컨트롤러에 Xbox 컨트롤러만큼 많은 시간을 보냈습니다. 저는 매우 운이 좋았거나 마이크로소프트는 경쟁사들보다 더 빨리 실패하도록 컨트롤러를 설계했습니다. 닌텐도의 제품에는 몇 가지 단점이 있지만, 가속도계 입력과 같은 추가 기능이 공식적으로 지원된다는 점은 주목할 만합니다.
저는 다른 플랫폼에서 계속 지원되는 한 이 컨트롤러를 계속 사용할 수 있기를 바랍니다. 그와 같은 컨트롤러가 많이 있지만, 이 컨트롤러는 제 것입니다.

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
플레이 스테이션 컨트롤러에 대한 짧은 언급으로 1차 파티 라인업을 마무리하겠습니다. 저는 그들을 좋아하지 않았습니다.
듀얼 슌크 1-3은 저에게 똑같이 느껴졌고 똑같은 결함이 있었습니다: 너무 가까이 붙어 있는 대형 덤벨 스틱, 매우 빨리 마모되는 것처럼 보이는 얼굴/어깨/트리거 버튼, 그리고 D 패드가 틀린 느낌이었습니다. 듀얼 슌크 4는 많은 문제를 해결했지만 새로운 문제를 많이 도입했습니다. 저는 듀얼 센스를 받았는데, 일부 친구들이 비대칭 덤벨 스틱에 어려움을 겪었고, 어떤 이유로 인해 현지 상점들이 DS4 컨트롤러보다 20달러나 저렴하게 팔고 있었기 때문입니다.
저는 이 컨트롤러를 실제로 사용하지 않습니다: 페이스 버튼이 너무 멀리 떨어져 있고, 연결되면 오디오 입/출력이 컨트롤러에 기본 설정되며, 범퍼가 이상하게 높고, 메뉴/공유를 치려고 할 때 실수로 트랙 패드를 누르는 경우가 많습니다.
그들은 디자인의 측면에서 많은 발전을 이룬 훌륭한 게스트 컨트롤러이지만, 저에게는 최대한의 참신함입니다.

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo는 제가 처음으로 접한 좋은 3rd 파티 컨트롤러였습니다. 이 오리지널 SN30 Pro(후기 버전은 홀 효과 스틱을 사용하며 SNES 색상으로 제공되지 않음)는 여전히 제가 가장 좋아하는 컨트롤러 중 하나입니다. 이 컨트롤러를 잡으면 제 첫 번째 콘솔인 SNES가 떠오릅니다.
나쁜 하루를 보내고 있고 향수를 느끼고 싶다면 제가 가장 먼저 찾는 컨트롤러입니다. 이 컨트롤러는 Switch Pro 컨트롤러의 모든 기능을 갖추고 있지만, SNES 컨트롤러의 현대화된 버전으로 압축되어 있으며 오목한 X/Y + 볼록한 A/B 버튼과 아마도 제가 사용해 본 것 중 가장 좋은 D-패드가 있습니다. 약간의 문제가 있지만 제게는 항상 위안이 되었습니다.
어느 날 스틱이 고장나거나 배터리가 마지막으로 방전되면, 그때가 되면 현대 버전(홀 효과 스틱 사용)으로 교체하고 케이스를 교체할 것입니다.
이렇게 연결되어 있으니 8BitDo가 이것보다 더 잘할 수 없을 것 같습니다. 그런데...

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
SN30 Pro의 익숙한 편안함과 현대 컨트롤러의 모든 기능을 원할 때, 8BitDo Pro 2는 다중 플랫폼 컨트롤러로 선택했습니다.
이것은 SN30 Pro에서 모든 기능을 업그레이드했습니다: 더 편안한 그립, 홀 효과 스틱, 아날로그 트리거, 프로그래밍 가능한 백 패들, 물리적 X/D/S/A 모드 토글 스위치, [어느 정도] 쉽게 교체할 수 있는 배터리, AAA 배터리를 사용할 수 있는 옵션. 나는 휴대 케이스와 휴대폰 홀스터도 구입했습니다. 휴대폰으로 사용하지는 않지만, 더 컴팩트한 복고풍 에뮬레이션 핸드헬드에 대해서는 정밀한 아날로그 컨트롤이 필요한 게임 목록을 확장할 수 있습니다.
이 컨트롤러에 대해 말할 수 있는 단점은 거의 없지만, 제가 소장한 컨트롤러 중 3위입니다. 제 2순위 선택에 대해서는 잠시 후에 이야기하겠습니다. 하지만 그 전에...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
N64 컨트롤러를 현대화하는 것이 얼마나 어려운가요?
저렴한 N64 모조 컨트롤러는 많지만, 3단계 원본은 객관적으로 나쁜 디자인이었습니다. 현명한 구성으로 얼굴 버튼을 C 버튼으로 작동하도록 하여 현대식 컨트롤러로 N64 게임을 플레이할 수 있었지만, 여러 가지 이유로 동일하지 않습니다.
이 아나크론주의적 난제를 해결하기 위해 RetroFighters Brawler 64를 받았고, 제 기대치를 훨씬 뛰어넘었습니다. Switch가 공식 NSO N64 컨트롤러로 인식할 수 있도록 공식 NSO N64 컨트롤러를 모방하도록 제작되었으며, 오른쪽 스틱이 없는 프로 컨트롤러로 인식되도록 전환할 수 있습니다.
문제는 있지만, 레이아웃과 호환성 덕분에 공식 버전이 가지고 있는 문제보다 훨씬 더 많은 문제를 해결합니다. N64 에뮬레이션을 보여주면서도 원본의 위협이나 현대식 컨트롤러를 조작하여 동일하게 작동하도록 하는 아나크론주의를 피할 수 있습니다.
그것이 하고자 하는 일을 아주 잘 해냅니다.

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
이 스팀 컨트롤러는 불 판매가 끝난 직후에 경매장에서 가격을 협상하여 구입했습니다. 약간의 손질이 필요했지만, 제가 할 수 있는 만큼 손질하여 다시 작동하게 했습니다.
이것은 제가 가지고 있는 컨트롤러 중 가장 커스터마이징이 가능한 것 중 하나로, 독특한 [혹은 의심스러운] 디자인과 시대를 앞서가는 기능(자이로 조준, 백 패들, 하트피드백 등)을 가지고 있습니다. 하지만 몇 가지 문제가 있습니다. 건전지가 필요하고, 유선 연결에는 마이크로 USB를 사용하며, 종종 꺼진 후 스스로 다시 켜지고, 백 패들은 피로감을 유발할 정도로 딱딱하며, 러버가 닳아서 캡이 필요하고, 스팀 입력에 대한 업데이트와 함께 기능이 변동하는 경향이 있습니다.
이것은 정기적으로 사용하는 입력 장치보다는 독특한 역사적 유물이지만, 비오는 날에는 즐겁게 뜯어볼 수 있는 멋진 추가물입니다.
또한 제 2의 선택은 아니며, 그 영예는...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth 컨트롤러는 거의 완벽한 컨트롤러입니다.
홀 효과 스틱, 충전 도크가 포함되어 있어 포함된 동글용 포트가 2중으로 사용 가능, 전용 2.4GHz/블루투스 전환 스위치, NS Pro 레이아웃으로 개선된 D-패드, 아날로그 트리거, 프로그래밍 가능한 백 패들. 이 컨트롤러로 소파에 앉아 있으면 스팀 덱과 스위치를 TV 입력 전환 시간보다 더 빠르게 전환할 수 있습니다.
하지만 몇 가지 단점도 있습니다. 안드로이드나 애플 모드가 없고(X/스위치 신호만), 트리거가 불편하고, 동글/스위치 연결 시간에 따라 입력 지연이 발생하는 것 같습니다.
이것이 최선이라고 생각했지만, Xbox 컨트롤러를 사용할 때처럼 연결된 동글/스위치 연결 시간에 따라 입력 지연이 발생하는 것 같습니다.

🧵 I now have a German telefonnummer! Exciting!
That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha

Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 넷플릭스, 이베이, 아마존, 젤레와 함께 제 계정이 '수상한 활동'으로 인해 정지되거나 사용이 제한되었습니다. 또한, 직장에서 '문제가 많은 상황'에 처하게 만드는 여러 시스템에 포함되었습니다. (즉, '악의적인 사용자'로 간주될 경우 발생할 수 있는 최악의 상황을 보여주는 일련의 절차입니다.)
프리넷 펑크는 처음 세 번 거절했지만, 네 번째 시도에서 성공했습니다. 드디어 그들의 SIM 카드를 받았습니다. 엑스파트리오는 처음에는 거절했지만, 결국 제 유효한 거주 증명서를 받아들였습니다(실제로 '멜데운' 증명서인데, 그들은 이 증명서가 유효하다고 말했습니다...). 그리고 지난주에 제 계정을 해제해 주었습니다. 그리고 사라진 돈은 결국 제 계좌로 입금되었습니다. 모든 것이 끔찍한 것은 아니지만, 제 삶을 최대한 어렵게 만들려는 시스템에 맞서 싸우는 기분입니다.
여기서 저는 이러한 문제가 실제로 디지털 시스템에 의한 차별이며, 해외로 이직해 온 사람에게는 이런 문제가 발생하지 않았을 것이라고 말할 수 있습니다. 하지만 저는 힘든 방법으로, 등록 없이 왔고, 한 시스템에서 문제가 발생하여 그 다음 시스템에도 영향을 미쳤을 것입니다. 이 모든 것은 제가 관광객처럼 행동하는 것을 그만두면서 시작되었습니다. 하지만 결국 제 '수상한 행동'은 해외로 갑자기 이사하는 것입니다. 이베이 직원이 전화로 직접 그렇게 말했습니다. (그들은 심지어 이사를 하는 것은 매우 드문 일이라고 말했습니다. 그래서 이베이의 경우, 이사를 하면 항상 문제가 발생할 것 같습니다.)
덧붙여서, 집주인에게 세탁 토큰을 사는 것은 정말 큰 승리였습니다! 몇 마디 단어를 외우고, 그에게 왓츠앱 메시지를 보냈더니 바로 전화가 와서 너무 놀랐습니다. xD

🧵 I now have a German telefonnummer! Exciting!
That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha
(*hes starting in Python! Which I think is the MOST fun, even if someone has to unlearn bad habits. I think its a valuable litmus test for those to see if programming is for them)

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha
(*hes starting in Python! Which I think is the MOST fun, even if someone has to unlearn bad habits. I think its a valuable litmus test for those to see if programming is for them)
tgt_seg:
이제 독일 전화 번호가 생겼어요! 신나네요!
제가 구입한 여행 SIM은 그 격차를 해소하는 데 도움이 되었지만, 서비스는 끔찍했고 로밍에 의존했습니다. 저는 또한 그것이 다이얼 할 수 있다는 인상을 받았지만, 그렇지 않았습니다. 저는 이미 독일 번호를 호출해야했습니다.
SIM 판매자는 또한 외국인이었습니다 (미국인이 아니었습니다) 그리고 나는 가장 좋은 대화를 나누었습니다! 그는 프로그래밍을 배우는 팁을 원했습니다 *, 그리고 나는 독일어를 배우는 데 얼마나 오래 걸리냐고 물었고 그는 매우 고무적이었습니다! 일을 위해 배워야하는 사람들은 훨씬 더 많이 더 빨리 배울 것이라고 말했습니다! 그는 그것을 계속하고 3 개월 안에 나는 괜찮을 것이라고 격려했습니다.
필연적으로 교환할 때 번호를 유지하려고 노력할 것입니다. 편리함을 위해 이것을 선택했습니다. 그는 심지어 저에게 주소를 요구하지 않았기 때문에, 활성화하기 위해 ID만 요구했습니다.
참고로, D-Netz가 Deez Nuts의 레퍼런스인 줄은 몰랐어요.
(*그는 파이썬으로 시작했어요! 제가 가장 재미있다고 생각하는데, 심지어 누군가가 나쁜 습관을 버려야 하는 경우에도 말이죠. 저는 그것이 프로그래밍이 그들에게 맞는지 알아보기 위한 귀중한 라크무스 테스트라고 생각합니다.)

src_seg:
🧵 Okay... I dont want the honeymoon phase to end >_>. More great German things plz :P
Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!
I've eaten Korean, Chinese, Taiwanese and Japanese cuisine now. And all of them have the distinct taste of.. sauerkraut?? But, it's in the rice itself. The part thats supposed to be the most neutral of flavor.
I made Gnocci Carbonarra (white sause) and, while it was funking delicious, tasted like Brätwurst. I thought I was safe making food at home, but I'm not xD. 
Now, I've eaten authentic italian in Syracuse NY (it's an italian historic city) and been to Taiwan. So I wonder if given time my taste buds will adapt and I will think everything tastes like how I remember it. Like as if there are subtle tones I'm just not used to yet 🤔 . And hense why I THINK everything has a foreign taste to it.
Aside: Also these arn't new foods to me so Im comparing them to what I know. Versus trying... say... Ethiopian cuisine (something new)

좋아요. 몇 가지 단점이 있습니다. 모든 음식의 맛은... 어떻게 말해야 할까요... 독일어 XD. 재미있게 그렇게!
저는 한국, 중국, 대만, 일본 요리를 먹었습니다. 그리고 그 모든 요리는 소스카로트의 독특한 맛을 가지고 있습니다. 하지만, 그것은 쌀 자체에 있습니다. 맛이 가장 중립적이라고 여겨지는 부분입니다.
나는 Gnocci Carbonarra (백색 소스) 를 만들었고, 맛이 좋았지만 Brätwurst처럼 맛있었습니다. 나는 집에서 음식을 만드는 것이 안전하다고 생각했지만, 나는 xD가 아닙니다.
이제, 저는 시라큐스 뉴욕 (이탈리아의 역사적인 도시) 에서 정통 이탈리아 음식을 먹었고 타이완에 다녀왔습니다. 그래서 시간이 지나면 제 입맛이 적응할 수 있을지 궁금합니다. 그리고 모든 것이 제가 기억하는 것처럼 맛있다고 생각하게 될 것입니다. 마치 제가 아직 익숙하지 않은 미묘한 톤이있는 것처럼 말이죠. 그리고 왜 모든 것이 낯선 맛을 가지고 있다고 생각하는지 궁금합니다.
또한 이 음식들은 저에게 새로운 것이 아니기 때문에 제가 알고 있는 것과 비교하고 있습니다. 예를 들어 에티오피아 요리 (새로운 것) 를 시도하는 것과 비교해서요.

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
넷플릭스는 Ebay, Amazon, Zelle와 함께 '미신스러운 활동'으로 인해 내 계정을 비활성화 / 잠금하는 목록에 합류했습니다. 그리고 더 큰 시스템 목록 중 하나는 우리가 일에서 "나쁜 흐름"이라고 부르는 것입니다. (가장 나쁜 배우의 최악의 시나리오를 보여주는 플로우 차트).
프리넷 펑크는 3번이나 거절했지만 4번은 통과했습니다. 마침내 그들의 SIM 카드를 받았습니다. 엑스파트리오는 처음 거절한 후 마침내 내 완전히 유효한 거주 증명서를 받아들였습니다. 그리고 지난 주에 내 계좌를 잠금 해제했습니다. 그리고 공백으로 들어간 돈은? 그것은 나타났습니다. 그래서 모든 것이 위험하게 나쁘지는 않지만, 나는 말 그대로 내 삶을 가능한 한 어렵게 만드는 데 몰두한 시스템에 대해 상류로 헤엄치고 있습니다.
그리고 여기서 저는 체계적인 억압이 문자 그대로 디지털 시스템이라는 것에 대해 이야기 할 수 있었습니다. 그리고 이 문제들이 어떻게 직장을 옮기기 위해 온 사람에게는 일어나지 않을지 이야기 할 수 있었습니다. 하지만 저는 어렵게, 등록되지 않고, 하나의 시스템을 표기했습니다. 그리고 저는 다음과 다음을 촉발시켰다고 확신합니다. 모든 것은 제가 관광 일을 그만두었을 때 시작되었습니다.:P. 하지만 결국 저의 의심스러운 행동은 갑자기 해외로 이동하고 있습니다. 저는 전화로 eBay 직원들에게 명시적으로 그렇게 말했습니다. 🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 넷플릭스가 이베이, 아마존, 젤레와 함께 제 계정을 '의심스러운 활동'으로 인해 비활성화/잠그는 목록에 합류했습니다. 그리고 직장에서 우리가 "문제의 흐름"이라고 부르는 상황에 빠뜨리는 더 많은 시스템들 속에서도요. (잠재적인 악의적인 사용자를 위한 최악의 시나리오를 보여주는 흐름도).
프리넷 펑크는 저를 3번이나 거부했지만, 4번째 시도는 통과했습니다. 드디어 심 카드를 받았습니다. 엑스파트리오는 처음 거부했던 제 유효한 거주 증명서를 결국 수락했고, 지난주에 제 계정을 해제했습니다. 그리고 공허 속으로 사라진 돈은 결국 다시 나타났습니다. 모든 것이 절망적인 것은 아니지만, 제 삶을 최대한 어렵게 만들려는 시스템에 맞서 헤엄치는 기분이 듭니다.
여기서 저는 시스템적인 억압이 실제 디지털 시스템이라는 점, 그리고 직장 이전을 통해 온 사람이면 이런 문제가 발생하지 않았을 것이라는 점에 대해 이야기할 수 있을 것입니다. 하지만 저는 등록되지 않은, 힘든 방법으로 이주해 왔고, 한 시스템이 다른 시스템을, 또 다른 시스템을 유발했다고 확신합니다. 모든 것은 관광객처럼 지내는 것을 멈춘 시점부터 시작되었죠 :P. 하지만 결국 제 의심스러운 행동은 갑작스럽게 해외로 이주하는 것입니다. 이베이 직원에게서 전화로 직접 그렇게 들었습니다. (그들은 또한 누군가가 나라를 옮기는 것이 극히 드물다고 말했습니다. 따라서 이베이의 경우, 항상 플래그가 지정될 것 같습니다).

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 넷플릭스도 eBay, 아마존, 제트(Zelle)에 이어 '의심스러운 활동'으로 인해 계정을 비활성화/차단하는 명단에 이름을 올렸어요. 직장에서 말하는 '나쁜 흐름(The Bad Flow)'에 해당하는 시스템들 중 하나가 되었죠. (가장 안 좋은 상황을 가정한 흐름도표입니다.)
Freenet Funk는 세 번이나 거부당했지만 네 번째에는 성공했어요. 드디어 SIM 카드를 받았습니다. Expatrio도 처음에는 거부했던 제 완벽히 유효한 거주 증명서(바로 제가 Anmeldung을 증명하는 서류였습니다. 그들이 유효하다고 명시했죠)를 마침내 승인하고 계정을 열어주었어요. 그리고 사라졌던 돈도 다시 나타났어요. 그래서 모든 것이 다 나쁜 건 아니지만, 저는 literal로 거대한 시스템의 역류 속을 헤엄치고 있는 셈이에요. 제 삶을 최대한 어렵게 만들려는 시스템 말이죠.
이쯤에서 시스템적 억압이 디지털 시스템 그 자체라는 이야기를 할 수 있겠네요. 이런 문제는 직장 이동으로 온 사람이라면 겪지 않았을 거예요. 저는 어려운 방법으로 왔고, 등록도 안 된 상태에서 한 시스템에서 플래그가 붙었고, 그로 인해 다음 시스템, 또 다음 시스템까지 연쇄적으로 문제가 생긴 거죠. 이 모든 건 제가 관광객 활동을 그만둔 무렵부터 시작되었어요 :P. 결국 제 '의심스러운 행동'은 갑작스럽게 해외로 이사한 것이었어요. 이건 이베이 직원이 직접 전화로 말해줬어요. (심지어 해외 이사는 정말 드문 일이라 의심받을 가능성이 높다고 했죠. 이베이의 경우라면 말이죠).
참고: 승리의 순간, 하우스마이스터에게 세제 코인을 구입한 것! 몇 단어를 외웠고, 왓츠앱으로 메시지를 보낸 뒤 그분이 즉시 전화를 걸어오셔서 깜짝 놀랐어요 xD.

Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

프리넷 펑크는 저를 3번 거절했지만 4번째에 통과했어요. 마침내 그들의 SIM 카드를 받았어요. 익스파트리오는 처음엔 거절했지만, 결국 제 완전히 유효한 거주 증명(안멜둥 증명서, 그들이 유효하다고 명시한)을 받아들이고 지난 주에 제 계정을 잠금 해제했어요. 그리고 사라진 돈? 다시 나타났어요. 그래서 모든 게 치명적으로 나쁜 건 아니지만, 저는 말 그대로 제 삶을 최대한 어렵게 만드는 시스템을 거슬러 올라가고 있어요.  
여기서 시스템적 억압이 말 그대로 디지털 시스템이라는 이야기를 할 수 있어요. 그리고 이 문제들은 직장 이동으로 온 사람에게는 일어나지 않을 거예요. 하지만 저는 어려운 길로 왔고, 등록되지 않았고, 한 시스템에 플래그가 되어 다음 시스템으로 이어졌어요. 모두 제가 관광객 모드를 그만둔 시점에서 시작되었어요 :P. 하지만 궁극적으로 제 의심스러운 행동은 갑작스럽게 해외로 이사한 거예요. 이베이 직원이 전화에서 분명히 말해줬어요. 🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 넷플릭스도 이베이, 아마존, 젤(Zelle)에 이어 '의심스러운 활동'을 이유로 제 계정을 비활성화하거나 잠가버린 목록에 합류했습니다. 그리고 직장에서 우리가 '최악의 시나리오(The Bad Flow)'라고 부르는 상황, 즉 악의적인 사용자일 가능성이 있는 사람에게 일어날 수 있는 최악의 시나리오 순서도 같은 것에 저를 몰아넣는 더 큰 시스템 목록 중에서요.
프리넷 펑크(Freenet Funk)는 저를 세 번이나 거절했지만 네 번째에는 승인해줬어요. 드디어 유심카드도 받았고요. 엑스파트리오(Expatrio)는 처음에는 제 유효한 거주 증명서(유효하다고 명시된 제 안멜둥 서류 원본이었는데도...)를 거절했지만, 마침내 받아들여서 지난주에 제 계정을 풀어줬어요. 그리고 허공으로 사라졌던 돈도요? 다시 나타났어요. 그러니 모든 게 절망적으로 나쁜 건 아니지만, 저는 말 그대로 제 삶을 최대한 어렵게 만들려고 작정한 시스템에 맞서 상류로 헤엄쳐 올라가고 있는 셈이에요.
그리고 여기서 저는 시스템적 억압이 말 그대로 디지털 시스템이라는 것과, 직장 발령으로 온 사람에게는 이런 문제가 일어나지 않을 거라는 점에 대해 이야기할 수 있겠죠. 하지만 저는 미등록 상태로 어려운 길을 택했고, 한 시스템에서 의심 대상으로 찍히니 다음, 또 그다음 시스템에서도 연달아 찍힌 게 분명해요. 이 모든 건 제가 관광객처럼 행동하는 걸 멈췄을 때쯤 시작됐어요 :P. 하지만 궁극적으로 제 의심스러운 행동은 갑작스러운 해외 이주인 거죠. 이베이 직원과 통화할 때 명시적으로 그렇게 들었어요. src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix는 Ebay, Amazon, Zelle과 함께 '의심스러운 활동'으로 인해 내 계정을 비활성화/잠금한 목록에 합류했습니다. 그리고 직장에서 우리가 '불운의 흐름'이라고 부르는 시스템에 저를 넣은 더 큰 목록 중 하나입니다. (가능성 있는 악성 행위자에 대한 최악의 시나리오를 보여주는 흐름도).
Freenet Funk는 저를 3번 거절했지만, 4번째에는 통과되었습니다. 드디어 그들의 SIM 카드를 받았습니다. Expatrio는 처음에 거절했던 제 완전히 유효한 거주 증명(그들이 유효하다고 말한 실제 안멜둥 증명)을 결국 받아들였고, 지난주에 제 계정을 해제했습니다. 그리고 공허 속으로 사라진 돈은? 결국 돌아왔습니다. 모든 것이 위험하게 나쁘지만, 저는 문자 그대로 제 삶을 최대한 어렵게 만들려는 시스템에 역류하며 헤엄치고 있습니다.
여기서 저는 시스템적 억압이 문자 그대로 디지털 시스템이라는 것과, 이러한 문제가 직장 이직으로 온 사람에게는 발생하지 않을 것이라는 점을 말할 수 있습니다. 하지만 저는 등록되지 않은 채 어려운 방법으로 왔고, 한 시스템에 플래그를 당한 것이 다음 시스템과 그 다음 시스템을 트리거한 것이 틀림없습니다. 모든 것이 제가 관광객 활동을 멈춘 무렵부터 시작되었습니다 :P. 하지만 결국 제 의심스러운 행동은 해외로 갑작스럽게 이주하는 것입니다. 이는 Ebay 직원이 전화로 직접 말했습니다. (그들은 사람이 국가를 옮기는 것이 매우 드물다고 말했습니다. 따라서 Ebay의 경우 항상 플래그를 당할 것 같습니다).
여담: 하우스마스터에게 세탁 토큰을 산 승리! 몇 마디를 외웠고, WhatsApp으로 연락하자 그가 즉시 전화를 걸어와서 저는 당황했습니다 xD.

And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

src_seg:
🧵 I now have a German telefonnummer! Exciting!
That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha
(*hes starting in Python! Which I think is the MOST fun, even if someone has to unlearn bad habits. I think its a valuable litmus test for those to see if programming is for them)
tgt_seg:
🧵 이제 독일 전화번호가 생겼어요! 신나요!
구매한 여행용 SIM 카드가 도움이 되긴 했지만, 서비스는 형편없었고 로밍에 의존해야 했어요. 또한, 제가 전화를 걸 수 있다고 생각했지만, 그럴 수 없었어요. 이미 독일 번호로 전화를 걸어야 했어요.
SIM 카드 판매자도 외국인(미국인은 아니에요)이었고, 정말 좋은 대화를 나눴어요! 그는 프로그래밍을 배우는 데 팁을 원했고, 저는 독일어를 배우는 데 얼마나 걸리는지 물었고, 그는 정말 영감을 주었어요! 일 때문에 배워야 하는 사람들은 훨씬 더 많이, 더 빠르게 배운다고 말했어요! 그는 저에게 계속하라고 격려했고, 3개월 후면 괜찮아질 거라고 했어요 🫶.
반드시 바꿔야 할 때 제 번호를 유지하려고 노력할 거예요. 편리함 때문에 이걸 선택했어요. 그가 저에게 주소도 요구하지 않고, 활성화하는 데 ID만 필요했기 때문이에요.
참고: 아니요, D-Netz가 디즈 너츠의 참고라고 생각하지 않았어요... 물론 아니에요 xD. 그렇게 생각하다니, 정말 우스워요 하하
(*그는 파이썬으로 시작하고 있어요! 누군가가 나쁜 습관을 버려야 하더라도, 제가 생각하기에 가장 재미있는 거예요. 프로그래밍이 자신에게 맞는지 확인할 수 있는 가치 있는 리트머스 시험이라고 생각해요)

🧵 Okay... I dont want the honeymoon phase to end >_>. More great German things plz :P
Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!
I've eaten Korean, Chinese, Taiwanese and Japanese cuisine now. And all of them have the distinct taste of.. sauerkraut?? But, it's in the rice itself. The part thats supposed to be the most neutral of flavor.
I made Gnocci Carbonarra (white sause) and, while it was funking delicious, tasted like Brätwurst. I thought I was safe making food at home, but I'm not xD. 
Now, I've eaten authentic italian in Syracuse NY (it's an italian historic city) and been to Taiwan. So I wonder if given time my taste buds will adapt and I will think everything tastes like how I remember it. Like as if there are subtle tones I'm just not used to yet 🤔 . And hense why I THINK everything has a foreign taste to it.
Aside: Also these arn't new foods to me so Im comparing them to what I know. Versus trying... say... Ethiopian cuisine (something new)

And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate.

And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
넷플릭스가 '의심스러운 활동'으로 인해 제 계정을 비활성화/잠금하는 목록에 Ebay, Amazon, Zelle과 함께 합류했습니다. 그리고 직장에서 '나쁜 흐름'이라고 부르는 더 많은 시스템 목록에 포함되었습니다. (악의적인 행위자로 추정되는 최악의 시나리오가 어떻게 진행되는지 보여주는 순서도).
프리넷 펑크는 세 번이나 저를 거부했지만 네 번째는 통과했습니다. 드디어 심카드를 받았습니다. Expatrio는 첫 번째 거부를 거부한 후 마침내 완전히 유효한 거주 증명서를 수락했고 (말 그대로 유효한 거주 증명서를 제출했습니다...) 지난 주에 제 계정을 잠금 해제했습니다. 그리고 공백으로 들어간 돈은? 나타났어요. 모든 것이 위험할 정도로 나쁜 것은 아니지만, 저는 말 그대로 제 삶을 최대한 어렵게 만드는 데 열중하는 시스템에 맞서 상류에서 헤엄치고 있습니다.
여기서 저는 말 그대로 디지털 시스템이라는 시스템적 억압에 대해 이야기할 수 있고, 이직으로 온 사람에게는 이런 문제가 발생하지 않을 것이라고 이야기할 수 있습니다. 하지만 저는 등록도 하지 않은 채 어렵게 들어와서 한 시스템을 신고했고, 그 신고가 다음 시스템과 그 다음 시스템을 촉발했다고 확신합니다. 이 모든 것은 제가 관광 일을 그만두면서부터 시작되었어요. 하지만 궁극적으로 저의 의심스러운 행동은 갑작스럽게 해외로 이동하는 것이었습니다. 이베이 직원에게 전화로 분명히 그렇게 들었습니다. (심지어 그들은 누군가가 국가를 옮기는 것은 극히 드문 일이라고 말했습니다. 그래서 이베이의 경우 항상 플래그가 표시되는 것처럼 들립니다).
제쳐두죠: 집 마이스터에게 세탁 토큰을 구입한 승리! 몇 마디 외워서 왓츠앱으로 메시지를 보냈더니 바로 전화가 왔어요.

🧵 I now have a German telefonnummer! Exciting!
That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha
(*hes starting in Python! Which I think is the MOST fun, even if someone has to unlearn bad habits. I think its a valuable litmus test for those to see if programming is for them)

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

제가 살아오면서 지금처럼 목마른 적은 한 번도 없었어요!
덧붙이자면, 비행기에서 있었던 이야기 한 가지가 있어요. 페디에 게재하기에는 적절치 않을 것 같아요. (나랑은 전혀 관계없는 이야기죠!)

src_seg:
🧵 I now have a German telefonnummer! Exciting!
That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha
(*hes starting in Python! Which I think is the MOST fun, even if someone has to unlearn bad habits. I think its a valuable litmus test for those to see if programming is for them)
tgt_seg:
🧵 드디어 독일 전화번호를 갖게 되었어요! 신나네요!
제가 구매한 여행용 SIM은 통신 격차를 어느 정도 해소하는 데는 도움이 됐지만, 서비스는 처참할 정도였고 로밍에 의존하는 것도 문제였죠. 제가 착각을 했던 건 그걸로 전화를 걸 수 있다는 점이었는데, 실제로는 전화를 걸 수가 없었어요. 원래 독일의 어느 번호로 전화를 걸어야 했었거든요.
그 SIM 판매원도 외국인이었는데, 대화가 정말 즐거웠어요! 그는 프로그래밍*을 배우는 팁을 얻고 싶었고, 저는 독일어를 어느 정도 기간 동안 공부해야 할지 물어봤죠. 그리고 그는 정말 훌륭한 조언을 해줬어요! 일을 위해선 반드시 공부해야 하는 것들은 훨씬 더 빠르고 효율적으로 배운다는 거예요. 저에게 꾸준히 공부하라고 격려해주셨고, 3개월 후면 충분히 잘할 수 있을 거라고 하셨죠. 🫶
어쩔 수 없이 바꾸게 될 테니까 번호를 유지할 거예요. 편의성 때문에 그 번호를 택했는데요. 번호를 활성화하는 데도 주소가 아니라 ID만 필요하다고 하더라고요.
참고로, 저는 D-Netz가 Deez Nuts에 대한 참조라고 생각한 적이 없어요... 당연히 그럴 리 없죠 ㅎㅎ. 그런 걸 생각할 정도로 멍청하시네요 ㅎㅎ
(*Python으로 시작하는군요! 저는 이것이 제일 재미있다고 생각해요. 비록 나쁜 습관을 버려야 하긴 하지만요. 프로그래밍이 자신에 맞는 것인지 알아보기 위한 소중한 시험이 될 것 같아요.)

주중에 하는 건 좋을 것 같아요. 저는 화요일부터 목요일까지 쾰른에 있는데, 16시부터 18시까지 수업이 있어요. 그래서 하루 중 가장 많은 시간을 밖에서 보낼 수 있겠네요! ☀️💜

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

프리넷 펑크(Freenet Funk)는 제 신청을 3번이나 거절했지만 4번째 신청은 통과됐어요. 드디어 SIM 카드를 받았어요. 엑스패트리오(Expatrio)는 저의 완전한 유효한 거주증을 처음에는 거절했지만, 제가 제공한 진짜 주민등록증은 유효하다고 했어요... 그래서 저의 계좌가 지난주 해제됐죠. 또 허공에 사라졌던 돈도 돌아왔네요. 모든 게 다 위험해서 안 좋은 건 아니지만, 제 삶을 최대한 험난하게 만들어버리려는 시스템과 맞서 싸우고 있는 건 사실이죠.
여기서 제가 말하고 싶은 것은 제도적 차별이 실질적으로 디지털 시스템에 기반한다는 점이고, 이러한 문제는 직장 파견으로 들어온 사람들에게는 발생하지 않을 거라는 점입니다. 하지만 저는 아무런 사전 등록 절차 없이 고된 방법을 통해 들어왔고, 한 시스템을 경고 표시하여 다른 시스템들이 차례로 경고 표시되는 계기를 만들었습니다. 그 모든 것은 제가 관광 여행을 하지 않은 시기에 시작되었습니다. ㅎㅎ 하지만 결국 의심스러운 행동으로 인해 해외로 옮겨갈 처지가 되었습니다. 뭐, 이베이 직원에게 전화를 했더니 그런 일이 벌어질 가능성은 극히 희박하다는 말을 받았습니다. 이베이의 경우에는 늘 경고가 표시되는 것 같습니다. (그들도 제가 다른 나라로 옮길 확률은 극히 희박하다고 말했습니다)
덧붙이자면, 한 가지 승리가 있었죠. 하우스마이스터로부터 세탁권을 구매하는 데 성공한 것입니다! 저는 몇 가지 단어를 외우고는 왓츠앱으로 전화를 했더니 그가 즉각 전화를 받더군요(xD).

Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha

나는 결국 전환할 때 내 번호를 유지하려고 노력할 거예요. 편리함 때문에 이걸 선택했어요. 그가 내게 주소를 요구하지 않았고, ID만으로 활성화할 수 있었거든요.  
별도의 이야기: 아니요, D-Netz가 Deez Nuts 드립이라 생각하지 않았어요... 당연히 아니죠 xD. 그렇게 생각하는 게 귀엽네요 하하.

Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha
(*hes starting in Python! Which I think is the MOST fun, even if someone has to unlearn bad habits. I think its a valuable litmus test for those to see if programming is for them)
tgt_seg:
🧵 이제 저는 독일 전화번호를 가지고 있어요! 신나요!

SIM 카드 판매원도 외국인(미국인은 아니었어요)이었고, 저는 그와 정말 좋은 대화를 나눴어요! 그는 프로그래밍을 배우는 데 대한 팁을 원했고, 저는 독일어를 배우는 데 얼마나 걸리는지 물었어요. 그는 정말 영감을 주는 말을 했어요! 일 때문에 배워야 하는 사람들은 더 많이, 더 빠르게 배운다고 말했어요! 그는 저에게 계속 하라고 격려했고, 3개월 후면 괜찮아질 거라고 말했어요 🫶.
저는 결국 번호를 바꿔야 할 때 제 번호를 유지하려고 노력할 거예요. 저는 편리함 때문에 이것을 선택했어요. 그가 저에게 주소를 요구하지 않고, 활성화를 위해 ID만 요구했기 때문이에요.
참고: 아니요, 저는 D-Netz가 디즈 너츠(Deez Nuts)의 참조라고 생각하지 않았어요... 물론 아니에요 xD. 그렇게 생각하는 당신이 바보예요, 하하
(*그는 파이썬으로 시작하고 있어요! 누군가가 나쁜 습관을 버려야 하더라도, 저는 그게 가장 재미있다고 생각해요. 저는 그게 프로그래밍이 자신에게 맞는지 알아보는 데 유용한 리트머스 시험이라고 생각해요.)

🧵 Okay... I dont want the honeymoon phase to end >_>. More great German things plz :P
Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!
I've eaten Korean, Chinese, Taiwanese and Japanese cuisine now. And all of them have the distinct taste of.. sauerkraut?? But, it's in the rice itself. The part thats supposed to be the most neutral of flavor.
I made Gnocci Carbonarra (white sause) and, while it was funking delicious, tasted like Brätwurst. I thought I was safe making food at home, but I'm not xD. 
Now, I've eaten authentic italian in Syracuse NY (it's an italian historic city) and been to Taiwan. So I wonder if given time my taste buds will adapt and I will think everything tastes like how I remember it. Like as if there are subtle tones I'm just not used to yet 🤔 . And hense why I THINK everything has a foreign taste to it.
Aside: Also these arn't new foods to me so Im comparing them to what I know. Versus trying... say... Ethiopian cuisine (something new)

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

src_seg:
🧵 I now have a German telefonnummer! Exciting!
That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha
(*hes starting in Python! Which I think is the MOST fun, even if someone has to unlearn bad habits. I think its a valuable litmus test for those to see if programming is for them)
tgt_seg:
🧵 이제 독일 전화번호를 가지고 있어요! 신나요!
그 여행용 SIM 카드를 샀는데, 간극을 메우는데 도움이 되었지만 서비스는 끔찍했고 로밍에 의존했어요. 또한 외출 통화가 가능하다고 생각했는데, 가능하지 않았어요. 이미 독일 번호를 걸어야 했거든요.
SIM 카드 판매원도 유학 중이던 사람(미국인이 아니었어요)이었고, 정말 즐거운 대화를 나눴어요! 그는 프로그래밍 배우는 데 팁을 달라고 했고, 저는 독일어 배우는 데 얼마나 걸리는지 물었어요. 그는 정말 영감을 주었어요! 일 때문에 배워야 하는 사람들은 더 많이, 더 빨리 배운다고 말이죠! 그는 제가 계속 노력하라고 격려했고, 3개월 후엔 괜찮아질 거라고 했어요 🫶.
필연적으로 번호를 바꿀 때도 이 번호를 유지하려고 노력할게요. 편의성 때문에 이걸 선택했어요. 그가 주소 대신 신분증만으로 활성화해줬거든요.
부록: 아니요, D-Netz가 Deez Nuts를 가리키는 줄은 몰랐어요... 물론이죠 xD. 그런 생각을 한 당신이 더 우스워요.
(*그는 파이썬으로 시작해요! 제가 생각하기에 가장 재미있는 언어고, 나쁜 습관을 고쳐야 하더라도요. 프로그래밍이 자신에게 맞는지 알아보는 가치 있는 시험이라고 생각해요)

src_seg:
🧵 Okay... I dont want the honeymoon phase to end >_>. More great German things plz :P
Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!
I've eaten Korean, Chinese, Taiwanese and Japanese cuisine now. And all of them have the distinct taste of.. sauerkraut?? But, it's in the rice itself. The part thats supposed to be the most neutral of flavor.
I made Gnocci Carbonarra (white sause) and, while it was funking delicious, tasted like Brätwurst. I thought I was safe making food at home, but I'm not xD. 
Now, I've eaten authentic italian in Syracuse NY (it's an italian historic city) and been to Taiwan. So I wonder if given time my taste buds will adapt and I will think everything tastes like how I remember it. Like as if there are subtle tones I'm just not used to yet 🤔 . And hense why I THINK everything has a foreign taste to it.
Aside: Also these arn't new foods to me so Im comparing them to what I know. Versus trying... say... Ethiopian cuisine (something new)

한국, 중국, 대만, 일본 음식을 먹어봤어. 그리고 그들 모두에 독특한 맛이... 김치? 하지만 밥 자체에 들어있어. 가장 중립적인 맛을 가져야 할 부분에.
그노치 카본아라(화이트 소스)를 만들었는데, 맛있긴 했지만 브래트워스트 맛이 났어. 집에서 요리하면 안전할 줄 알았는데, 아니었어 xD.
이제 정통 이탈리아 음식을 시라큐스, 뉴욕에서 먹어봤고 대만도 가봤어. 시간이 지나면 내 미각이 적응해서 모든 게 내가 기억하는 맛처럼 느껴질까? 마치 아직 익숙하지 않은 미묘한 음의 차이를 느끼는 것처럼 말이야 🤔. 그래서 모든 게 외국 맛처럼 느껴지는 것 같아.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 넷플릭스가 이베이, 아마존, 젤레와 함께 제 계정을 '의심스러운 활동'으로 인해 비활성화/잠금 조치했습니다. 직장에서 "트러블 발생"이라고 부르는 상황에 빠뜨리는 시스템 목록에 추가된 셈이죠. (잠재적 악의 사용자를 위한 최악의 시나리오를 보여주는 흐름도).
프리넷 펑크는 3번이나 거절했지만, 4번째 시도는 통과했습니다. 드디어 심 카드를 받았습니다. 엑스파트리오는 처음 거절했던 제 유효한 거주 증명서를 결국 받아들여 지난주에 계정을 해제했습니다. 그리고 돈이 증발했었어. 모든 것이 절망적인 것은 아니지만, 제 삶을 힘들게 하려고 하는 시스템에 맞서 싸우는 기분이 듭니다.
여기서 저는 시스템적인 억압이 실제 디지털 시스템이라는 점, 그리고 직장 이전을 통해 온 사람이면 이런 문제가 발생하지 않았을 거라는 점에 대해 이야기할 수 있을 것 같습니다. 하지만 저는 불법적으로, 등록되지 않은 상태로 왔고, 한 시스템이 다른 시스템을, 또 다른 시스템을 유발했다고 확신합니다. 모든 것은 관광객처럼 지내는 것을 그만두기 시작했을 때부터 시작되었죠 :P. 하지만 결국 제 의심스러운 행동은 갑작스럽게 해외로 이어진 것입니다. 이베이 직원에게 전화로 명확하게 들었습니다. 맙소사.. 저는 부동산 중개인을 만났고, (대부분의) 집을 싸고, 물건의 1/3을 나눠주었으며, 적절한 사람들이 나머지 물건에 접근할 수 있게 했습니다. 그리고 만약 필요하다면 제 여동생이 PoA가 될 수 있습니다. 7개 정도의 문서를 공증했고, 독일에서 학위를 인정받았으며, 언어 과정을 예약했고, (사기일 수도 있는) 아파트 임대를 예약했으며, 중요한 문서를 확인했습니다! 또한 저는 범죄자가 아니라는 국제적으로 인증된 문서도 가지고 있습니다! 이제 시작입니다!

🧵 I now have a German telefonnummer! Exciting!
That travel sim I bought did help bridge the gap, but the service was horrendous and relied on roaming. I was also under the impression it could dial out, which it could not. I already needed to call a German number.
The SIM salesperson was also an expat (not american) and I had the nicest conversation! He wanted tips with learning programming*, and I asked how long to learn German and he was super inspiring! Saying that those who must learn—like for work—learn much more and faster! He encouraged me to keep with it and in 3 months I should be fine 🫶. 
I will try to keep my numver when I inevitably switch. I chose this from convenience. Being that he didnt even require me an address, only an ID to activate. 
Aside: no, I didnt think D-Netz was a Deez Nuts reference... Ofc not xD. You're silly for even thinking that haha
(*hes starting in Python! Which I think is the MOST fun, even if someone has to unlearn bad habits. I think its a valuable litmus test for those to see if programming is for them)

필연적으로 전환할 때 번호를 유지하려고 노력할 거예요. 편의를 위해 이것을 선택했어요. 그는 주소를 요구하지 않고 활성화를 위해 ID만 요구했어요.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
